Based on the screenshot, here is the description of the expanded state:

1.  **Expanded Button:** The **"Breakfast"** button is the one that is expanded. It is visually distinct because it has a **dark brown/gold background** (unlike the white background of the others) and is slightly taller to accommodate the full text "Breakfast". Inside this button, there is a small icon of toast/eggs and the text **"Break... Tap again"**, indicating it is currently selected or active.
2.  **Hint Text:** Yes, the hint **"Tap again"** is visible directly underneath the truncated "Break..." text within that specific button.
3.  **Other Buttons:** Yes, the other category buttons (**Lunch**, **Dinner**, and **Snacks**) remain in their normal compact state with a plain white background and simple black text.
